Reference / crypto/kdf

crypto/kdf#

Key derivation.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let key = HkdfSecret(KdfHash.sha256, shared, salt, info, 32).secret();

Description#

Key derivation. HkdfSecret is HKDF (RFC 5869) extract-and-expand from input keying material: salt and info are public context, the output length is 1..255 hash lengths. Pbkdf2Secret is PBKDF2-HMAC (RFC 8018) for password stretching; prefer crypto/password (Argon2id) for stored passwords. Both derive only when secret() is observed and return fresh SecretBytes; inputs are exported from their SecretBytes at that moment.
